title: Dragon and Child at Pier
description: A young girl in a green coat walks across a torn purple fabric foreground, pulling a golden rope attached to a small green dragon with a wagon wheel and lantern on its back. They stand on a wooden pier leading to a lighthouse at sunset, all enclosed within a surreal, decaying picture frame with pins, peeling paint and floating eyes.
prompt: A young girl wearing a green coat walks across a torn purple fabric surface, pulling a thick golden rope. Beside her is a small green dragon wearing a harness with a wagon wheel and lantern. They are on a wooden pier leading toward a distant lighthouse at sunset. The entire scene is contained within a heavily damaged, decaying picture frame with peeling gold paint, pins, and floating eyes in green mist, surreal fantasy style.
